mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, application_id, application_version_id, template_id, template_version_id, source_key, object_code, record_id, scene, task_id, process_instance_id, process_run_id, actor, data_mode, generated_at, result, error_code, page_count, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_print_execution (tenant_id, application_id, application_version_id, template_id, template_version_id, source_key, object_code, record_id, scene, task_id, process_instance_id, process_run_id, actor, data_mode, generated_at, result, error_code, page_count, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{applicationId}, #{applicationVersionId}, #{templateId}, #{templateVersionId}, #{sourceKey}, #{objectCode}, #{recordId}, #{scene}, #{taskId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{processRunId}, #{actor}, #{dataMode}, #{generatedAt}, #{result}, #{errorCode}, #{pageCount}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createDept}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_print_execution WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND actor = #{actor} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_print_execution SET result = #{result}, page_count = #{pageCount}, error_code = #{errorCode}, update_by = #{actor}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND actor = #{actor} AND del_flag = 0 AND result = 'PREPARED' AND #{result} IN ('DIALOG_OPENED', 'PDF_DOWNLOADED', 'FAILED') AND (#{pageCount} IS NULL OR #{pageCount} BETWEEN 1 AND 50) AND (#{result} NOT IN ('DIALOG_OPENED', 'PDF_DOWNLOADED') OR (#{pageCount} IS NOT NULL AND #{errorCode} IS NULL))
